client_brief:
Apexguard imagery and recovered logo for a tightly defined six-SKU release

Release scope: six product SKUs
- V-PPF-104, V-PPF-105 and V-PPF-107
- U-TNT-204 and U-TNT-208
- F-HW-301

What we need back
- Industrial surfaces dealer poster: 1 named export. The correct Apexguard sub-brand is used: the poster is for the one sub-brand that carries the most SKUs in this release, named exactly as in our brand notes. The advertised application is supported by source imagery: the poster shows that sub-brand's product applied to a car in one of our supplied photographs, and advertises no use those photographs do not show.
- Surface product-page module: 6 named exports. The product variant is identified accurately: each module carries its SKU, sub-brand, fitment line and warranty term exactly as in its row of apexguard_skus.csv. The surface finish retains its source texture.
- Sub-brand application sheet: 1 named export. The sub-brand hierarchy is clear: the Apexguard master mark leads, and Vantage, Umbra and Forge sit beneath it, each smaller than the mark. The approved master lettering is preserved: the recovered mark keeps its own letterforms and letter spacing and is scaled, not re-tracked or reset in another face, to span its panel; the sheet shows it on our house dark ground, large and at thumbnail-sticker size.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files. Wherever our master mark appears, use the lettering recovered from the box sticker and shop-glass decal, scaled to span its panel with the accent bar beneath, rather than resetting it in a typeface.

brand_identity.tagline: Built to sit behind the counter
brand_identity.sector: An automotive aftermarket supplier of paint protection film, window tint and installation hardware, sold to independent installers.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Charlotte, North Carolina; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
brand_identity.about: Apexguard is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is Charlotte, North Carolina, and this commission covers phase 1: rebrand photography and product rollout.
brand_identity.audience: Independent installers, 25 to 45, who judge a supplier on whether the packaging justifies the price to a customer standing at the counter.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Line items from two hundred fifty to twelve hundred dollars, a confident premium supplier rather than a bright discount accessory brand.

palette.name: House black
palette.usage: The house dark ground: the page ground of the dealer poster and the sub-brand application sheet, and any panel on a product-page module, as the card ground of apexguard_label_2025.pdf and the house ground in apexguard_brand_notes.txt. Also the type colour on the plain white ground of a product-page module.

palette.name: Gunmetal
palette.usage: Secondary panels, keylines and photo frames on House black, as the keyline round the part photograph on apexguard_label_2025.pdf. On House black it may carry only a small, quiet label, as that label's SKU line; on plain white it may carry secondary labels. Never the page ground, a fitment line or a product-module SKU.

palette.name: Cool steel
palette.usage: Secondary type on House black or Gunmetal: the product family line and field labels such as Roll width and Warranty, as on apexguard_label_2025.pdf. Never a ground or panel, and never type on a white ground.

palette.name: Signal accent
palette.role: mandatory wherever the master mark appears; otherwise an optional accent
palette.usage: The one accent: the 6 pt bar locked beneath the master mark, the small bar inside the mark's chevron, a short bar beneath a sub-brand name, and at most one small caption, as the 6 pt bar beneath the master mark (type system), and the bar under VANTAGE and the FITMENT caption on apexguard_label_2025.pdf. Never a ground, panel or body text.

palette.name: Off white
palette.role: mandatory where type sits on House black or Gunmetal
palette.usage: Primary type and the reversed master mark on House black and Gunmetal: sub-brand names, fitment lines and record values, as on apexguard_label_2025.pdf. It may also be the plain white ground behind a part on a product-page module.

brand_identity.typography: Apexguard runs Clash Display for display, Aktiv Grotesk for text and Roboto Mono for SKUs. Step 01, display and H1, is Clash Display Bold all caps at 140 pt on 147 pt, tracked to span the exact full measure of its panel, flush at both edges and never below 120 units, with a 6 pt signal accent bar locked directly beneath at one fifth that measure. Step 02, the poster headline, is Clash Display Bold all caps at 60 pt on 66 pt, tracked plus 40 units. Step 03, body and fitment, is Aktiv Grotesk Regular at 16 pt on 24 pt, sentence case, tracking 0, measure held to 65 characters, and a fitment line is never tracked or condensed. Step 04, fine print, is Aktiv Grotesk Regular at 10 pt on 15 pt, tracked plus 10 units, carrying warranty and box copy, while SKUs break out into Roboto Mono Medium at 40 px on 46 px in a product module with the variant line at 28 px on 34 px.
brand_identity.voice: Confident and terse, no hype. Example line: 'Film, tint and hardware. Fitted right, backed properly.' No mascots, no vintage badges, no heavy gradients.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: Our master mark survives only on a die-cut box sticker and on a decal on an installer's shop glass. The studio that drew it has closed and taken the source files, so it has to be recovered as usable artwork.
brand_identity.values: A dark, high-contrast house system with one accent, where fitment information is always legible on the shelf. No mascots, no vintage badges, no heavy gradients.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: The caps mark is always tracked out to span the exact full measure of its panel, flush at both edges and never below 120 units, with a 6 pt signal accent bar locked directly beneath at one fifth that measure.

type_system.tagline: Built to sit behind the counter

scale.tracking: 120 units minimum, fitted to the panel measure
scale.note: The master mark: tracked out until it spans the exact full measure of its panel, flush at both edges, never below 120 units, with a 6 pt signal accent bar locked directly beneath at one fifth that measure.
Poster headline. It is tracked for caps colour, but only the mark is fitted edge to edge.

scale.sample: Paint protection film, window tint and installation hardware.
scale.note: Fitment and body, sentence case and untracked. A fitment line is never tracked or condensed to fit.
Warranty and box copy. SKUs break out into Roboto Mono Medium, 40 px on 46 px in a product module, with the variant line under it at 28 px on 34 px.

type_system.signature_move: The caps mark is always tracked out to span the exact full measure of its panel, flush at both edges and never below 120 units, with a 6 pt signal accent bar locked directly beneath at one fifth that measure. Step 01 is that mark, so its tracking is fitted to the panel rather than fixed, and the accent bar travels with it.
rules: Never track or condense a fitment line.
The mark is always tracked to span the exact full measure of its panel, flush at both edges, never below 120 units.
A 6 pt signal accent bar locks directly beneath the mark at one fifth that measure.
Display and the master mark always all caps in Clash Display Bold.
Fitment, warranty and body always sentence case and untracked in Aktiv Grotesk Regular; SKUs always in Roboto Mono Medium.
One accent only, and fitment information stays legible on the shelf.
No mascots, no vintage badges, no heavy gradients.

palette_rules.distribution: Grounds: House black #101114 is the page ground of the dealer poster and the sub-brand application sheet and the colour of any panel on a product-page module, as on apexguard_label_2025.pdf; Gunmetal #3A3D42 may be a secondary panel or keyline. On each product-page module the part sits on plain white, as the product page rule in apexguard_brand_notes.txt asks: Off white #F2F1ED or pure white #FFFFFF, flat. Type: on House black or Gunmetal, primary type and the reversed mark are Off white and secondary labels Cool steel #B7BCC2, with Gunmetal for a small quiet label, as on apexguard_label_2025.pdf; on plain white, type is House black, with Gunmetal for secondary labels. Signal accent #E4552B is the one accent, for the bar beneath the mark, the small bar in its chevron, a short bar beneath a sub-brand name, as on apexguard_label_2025.pdf, and at most one small caption, together no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area, never a ground, panel or body text.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph: a text panel sits over or beside the photograph as a solid block.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the five palette hexes (#101114, #3A3D42, #B7BCC2, #E4552B and #F2F1ED) for type, panels, rules, buttons, icons or the mark, except pure white #FFFFFF as the plain white ground behind a part on a product-page module; no second accent colour; no gradient, glow, chrome or metallic effect on any type, panel, rule, button or icon, since the brand allows no heavy gradients and nothing flashy; no mascot, vintage badge or tuner styling.
palette_rules.photography: Photographs keep their own corrected colour and surface texture and are never recoloured toward the palette: the black-anodized, gunmetal and stainless parts in the bench frames keep their own finish, not pushed to House black or Gunmetal.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Preserve identity, product geometry, material behavior, and documentary truth; retouching may improve presentation but may not change what the subject is.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
